headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Gross margin held at 26.0% (+18 bps YoY) even as landed milk cost rose 18% YoY to INR 45/L, as calibrated price hikes and a richer mix absorbed the inflation.
EBITDA (ex-other income) grew 38.6% YoY to INR 987 Mn and margin expanded 89 bps to 7.95%, despite ~INR 200 Mn of incremental A&P.
Reported PAT fell 8.0% YoY to INR 420 Mn as the effective tax rate normalised to 23.9% (9.6% in Q2FY26) and the base carried a INR 160 Mn one-off FCCB MTM gain; excluding it, PAT grew 42% YoY.
New- age brands (Avvatar and Pride of Cows) grew 71% YoY to INR 1,540 Mn (12.4% of sales), flagship categories grew 20% in value and 7% in volume, and ingredients rose 52%.
valuation: Valuation and Outlook: Parag Milk Foods is moving steadily from a commodity dairy processor to a branded health and nutrition company.
watch: Valuation and Outlook: Parag Milk Foods is moving steadily from a commodity dairy processor to a branded health and nutrition company.
Key risks include persistent milk inflation, rising competition in protein and premium dairy, and delays in normalizing inventory and debt.
